description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for handling WebSocket client connections, including client message handling, connection management, and specific handlers for connection, forwarding, polling, and configuration within a WebRTC operator component.

classes.name: ClientHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class for handling client messages, providing a virtual method for sending device messages.

classes.name: ClientWSHandler
classes.description: WebSocket handler for WebRTC client connections, managing message handling, connection requests, and forwarding.

classes.name: ClientWSHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WebSocket handlers for clients, based on device registry and server configuration.

classes.name: PollConnectionStore
classes.description: Stores and manages poll connection handlers identified by connection IDs.

classes.name: ClientDynHandler
classes.description: Base class for dynamic client handlers supporting GET and POST operations, and polling.

classes.name: ConnectHandler
classes.description: Handles connection requests from clients, associating them with device registry.

classes.name: ConfigHandler
classes.description: Handles configuration GET and POST requests, providing access to server configuration.

methods.name: SendDeviceMessage
methods.description: Virtual method to send a device message to the client.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages based on their type.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket handler instance.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a poll connection handler by ID.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new poll connection handler and returns its ID.

methods.name: DoPostInner
methods.description: Inner handler for POST requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Reply
methods.description: Sends a JSON reply to the client.

methods.name: ReplyError
methods.description: Sends an error message to the client.

methods.name: ConnectHandler
methods.description: Handles connection requests, associating clients with devices.

methods.name: DoPostInner
methods.description: Inner handler for POST requests specific to connection handling.

methods.name: DoPostInner
methods.description: Inner handler for POST requests specific to forwarding.

methods.name: DoPostInner
methods.description: Inner handler for POST requests specific to polling.
